screens.route: /pregled-zadatka (base mode: review before publishing, and the edit review of an existing task)
screens.purpose: The moment of truth of the new-task flow (AUDIT.md: class FLOW, pushed over /nova, left by replace per _layout.tsx FLOW_BEHIND). The owner sees the task exactly as others will see it, learns what still blocks publication, corrects single facts in place, and taps ONE green 'Objavi zadatak' ('Potvrdi izmene i objavi' when review.draftId is set). After the tap the same screen shows the outcome of the stored command (published, private draft, evaluation outcome, unknown) with one way forward.
problems: Three ways back to the conversation for one idea (AUDIT.md row /pregled-zadatka): chrome arrow 'Nazad u razgovor' (src/app/(app)/pregled-zadatka.tsx:331), 'Dopuni u razgovoru' in the block notice (:338), 'Izmeni u razgovoru' at the bottom of the scroll (:398).

The place is scattered over four spots: the long multi-line 'Lokacija' fact row (task_geography via rows(), :352; text from src/data/aiNeedV2Ui.ts:103-105), a lone muted privacy line (:360), the private address inside 'Privatni podaci' (:362-365), and 'Uredi mesto'/'Dodaj mesto' as the LAST quiet button of the scroll (:399), far from any place information.

Orange budget blown: block reason (:336), location conflict (:339), identity notice (:355) and every non-published outcome (:393) all use s.notice = orangeSoft fill (:450). Up to four orange fills on a screen whose primary is green.
The block reason is said twice: orange box at the top (:336-338) and again as the caption under the publish button (:428).

The category is named to the owner: blockReason maps review.missingRequired through factLabel (:248), so a missing need.category reads 'Još nedostaje: Kategorija.' This breaks the owner decision of 2026-09-21 that IntakePresentation.tsx:178-182 already applies (hiddenMissing).

Time rows break the one time format: 'Početak'/'Kraj' print factReviewValue = '3. okt 2026 · 17:00:00 (vreme u Beogradu)' with SECONDS and a private zone phrase (aiNeedV2Ui.ts:125-134, zonedParts in calendarPresentation.ts:13-17 returns HH:MM:SS), while the deadline row on the same screen uses dogovorenoVreme ('12. okt · 12:15', napomenaZone only off-zone).
Instrument output in the private section: the need.resolved_location row prints 'N od M tačaka · RS' and raw 6-decimal coordinates per point (aiNeedV2Ui.ts:106-118). The country appears as a code.

Money row 'Iznos' prints '1500 RSD' without grouping (aiNeedV2Ui.ts:125-126) while every other money in the app is novac() ('1.500 RSD'); price is spread over three rows (Cena / Iznos / Osnova cene) and never shown as the value slot people actually see.

The task is not shown as others see it: only a bare hero title (:346-350) + caption (:351) + a table of label/value rows. There is no task face (value slot, place, time, people) although DraftCard in IntakePresentation.tsx:106-155 already draws that face from the same facts.

Loading is a bare ActivityIndicator above an empty scroll (:333); with no review and an error the body is empty and only the footer shows 'Učitaj pregled i proveri ishod' plus a red line (:403-404). No StateView.
SuccessMark fresh is drawn on every render of a published command (:393), so re-opening an already published review from Moji zadaci replays the spring and haptic; motion must be a real state change.

Card look: the private section is a wash box (s.private :448) and notices are rounded fills; the rows (s.field :446) are fine hairline rows but every row has its own green 'Izmeni' (:301-310), which is the wall the earlier rework tried to calm.
KeyboardAvoidingView has behavior undefined on Android (:330): the inline correction TextInput near the sticky footer can end under the keyboard.
composition: CHROME: keep DetailTopBar (ScreenChrome detail) exactly: backLabel 'Nazad u razgovor', onBack=back, title published ? 'Objavljeno' : revising ? 'Pregled izmena' : 'Pregled zadatka' (test pins 'Pregled izmena'). The arrow becomes the ONLY general way back to the conversation: delete the bottom 'Izmeni u razgovoru' V2Action (:398) and the notice's 'Dopuni u razgovoru' (:337-338); the conversation is reached from the matching 'Još treba' row (see below).
STATE A — no review yet, loading (editor.loading && !review): <StateView kind='loading' title='Pripremamo pregled…' skeleton={{ count: 1, rows: 4, variant: 'task' }} />. Footer empty.

STATE B — no review, error (!review && !editor.loading): <StateView kind='error' art='document' title='Pregled nije učitan' body={editor.error ?? 'Pokušaj ponovo.'} primary={{ label: 'Učitaj pregled i proveri ishod', onPress: refresh, disabled: editor.busy || editor.loading }} />. The footer does NOT also render that button (the label must stay unique: tests find it with findByProps).
WITH A REVIEW, scroll content top to bottom (ScrollView padding 20, gap 24, white):

1) STATUS BLOCK (only when command exists): replaces the old result notice (:393-394). PUBLISHED with readback: row on greenSoft inset (radius control, padding 16): <SuccessMark fresh={publishedHere} size={40} /> + T body 'Zadatak je objavljen.' / 'Izmene su objavljene.' (unchanged copy). `publishedHere` = a ref set true only when this mount's accept()/resume() led to the published read; a restored published command draws SuccessMark fresh={false}. Every other command state: neutral `inset` on sys.color.wash with FactArt 'info' 20 + the unchanged resultCopy strings (:256-265). Support entry for outcome REVIEW stays directly under it (:395-397, unchanged).

2) PREVIEW — caption T meta muted 'Ovako će drugi videti zadatak' (pinned text, keep exactly), then ONE card (`cardCompact` hairline, no shadow) built from the TaskFace parts exactly like DraftCard: CardTitle (title fact, 3 lines max) with CardValue beside it (stacked under it when useTextScale() >= 1.3); CardFact pin/remote = zone; CardFact calendar = schedule (2 lines); CardFact users = people. Data: move `publicSummary()` and its helpers `fixedRange`/`schedules` unchanged out of src/ui/v2/IntakePresentation.tsx into a new pure module src/ui/v2/draftSummary.ts (no service/supabase import) and use it from both. Value slot: summary.value; if it is null AND the price_mode fact exists, show { kind: 'unpriced' } (quiet label 'Cena nije navedena', never money style); if price_mode is absent draw no slot. The card is not pressable (no caret). Description (need.description) is NOT repeated in the card.

3) JOŠ TREBA (only when !command and at least one item): header T heading 'Još treba' (accessibilityRole header). Items are hairline rows (min height 56, gap 12): WaitingDot (TaskFace export) + T body text + CaretRight when pressable. Order and copy: (a) safety BLOCK -> 'Sadržaj ne može da se objavi u ovom obliku.' press -> back(); (b) missing required without need.category -> 'Nedostaje: ' + labels joined ', ' + '.' press -> back(); if need.category is the ONLY missing key -> 'Treba još malo o samom poslu.' press -> back(); never name the category; (c) !review.location -> 'Mesto na mapi nije potvrđeno.' press -> openLocation(); (d) factProblem (REVIEW_FACT_COPY strings unchanged) -> pressable only when the target fact row has an id (price_rsd for MY_PRICE_AMOUNT_REQUIRED, starts_at for the two window problems) and opens that row's inline editor, otherwise static; (e) unavailable identity -> not a row but a block: T meta IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE_COPY + T body 'U ovom pregledu je ostao uslov koji aplikacija ne može da proveri. Ukloni ga izričito da nastaviš običnim zadatkom.' + the unchanged quiet V2Action 'Nastavi bez uslova provere identiteta' (:355-359 moved, same guards). Rows are Press (NOT V2Action) so no V2Action label is duplicated. No fill: white, hairlines, orange only as the dots.

4) MESTO section: header row T heading 'Mesto' + trailing V2Action kind quiet compact label review.location ? 'Uredi mesto' : 'Dodaj mesto' (same labels, same openLocation, same disabled rule disabled || !!edit || deadlineEditor; hidden when command). If snapshot.locationConflict: warn inset (warnSoft, no orange fill) with the unchanged alert text 'Mesto je promenjeno posle prethodnog pregleda. Prikazano je trenutno mesto; pregledaj ga ili izmeni pre objave.' Then two labelled groups: 'Vide svi' (FactArt eye 18 + T label): the public place line = summary.zone (or 'Na daljinu'); for a route the geographyReview text of task_geography as note lines; and, when the review has a confirmed anchor point, a read-only map <ResolvedPinMap position={publicAnchor} coarse disabled height={160} scopeKey={`${accountId}:${reviewId}:preview`} onChoose={() => {}} />. publicAnchor comes from a NEW pure helper `publicAnchorPoint(location)` in src/lib/location.ts that mirrors private.materialize_resolved_location (migration 20260910130851, lines 221-231): slot = 'serviceArea' when geography.mode is AREA_BASED and serviceArea exists, else 'start'; lat/lng = sign(E6) * Math.round(abs(E6) / 1e4) / 100 (Postgres round is half away from zero). No anchor point -> no map, no invented point. Under it T note muted, unchanged meaning: 'Na javnoj mapi prikazuje se približno područje. Tačne tačke ostaju privatne.' Then 'Samo u Dogovoru' (FactArt lock 18 + T label): the ownerPrivateProjection rows (see 6) live here. When REMOTE: only 'Na daljinu', no map, no private group.

5) FOTOGRAFIJE section: header row T heading 'Fotografije' + trailing quiet compact V2Action 'Uredi fotografije' / 'Dodaj fotografije' (same labels, same guarded navigate push to /fotografije-zadatka, hidden when command). Body: 3-column grid of square AuthorizedPhoto tiles (width (100% - 2*8)/3, gap 8, contentFit cover, labels 'Fotografija zadatka N'), or T meta muted 'Fotografije nisu dodate.'

6) DETALJI — the edit rows (public facts, then the private ones inside Mesto/Samo u Dogovoru). Rows keep rows()/row() logic: same filters (drop need.category, need.title, need.public_photo_paths; ALSO drop need.task_geography and need.task_country_code from the public list because section 4 shows them, their Izmeni still opens the place editor from the Mesto header), same showEmpty line, same inline editors (FactTimestampEditor / FactListEditor / TextInput), same 'Sačuvaj ispravku' / 'Odustani od ispravke', same 'Izmeni: <label>' accessibilityLabel and guards. Visual: hairline rows, label T meta muted, value T body ink; value inline right when <= 16 chars AND useTextScale() < 1.3, else under the label; trailing 'Izmeni' is T meta 600 green in a 48x48 Press (unchanged). Displayed value = NEW pure `reviewRowValue(fact)` in src/data/aiNeedV2Ui.ts: TIMESTAMPTZ -> dogovorenoVreme(value) (no seconds, '(po vremenu u Srbiji)' only off-zone); need.price_rsd -> novac(value); need.resolved_location -> `${done} od ${total} tačaka potvrđeno` plus per point 'Adresa tačke: …' / 'Pristup: …' lines, never coordinates or the country code; everything else delegates to factReviewValue. factReviewValue itself stays unchanged (it seeds corrections and its tests pin exactness). The 'Nije navedeno: …' opener (:282-286) stays a Press with the same accessibilityLabel prefix 'Prikaži šta nije navedeno' and adds <TurningCaret open={false} /> at its end. 'Podrazumevana vrednost' stays. Private rows keep the heading T 'Privatni podaci' and the sentence 'Ovi podaci nisu deo javnog zadatka. Pristup ostaje prema pravilima Dogovora.' verbatim (privacy text), now without the wash box.

7) PRIJAVE section: header T heading 'Prijave' + trailing quiet compact V2Action 'Uredi rok za prijave' (same label/guards, hidden when command). Body: T body review.responseDeadline ? `Rok: ${dogovorenoVreme(deadline)}` : 'Bez posebnog roka — do popune ili dok ne zaustaviš potragu.' + T note muted 'Zadatak sa tačnim terminom se zatvara kad termin prođe.' (both strings keep the pinned words). deadlineEditor open -> ResponseDeadlineEditor inline in this section exactly as :385-386.

FOOTER (sticky, hairline top, padding lg, gap sm; unchanged logic :402-434): editor.error as T alert danger (only when a review exists); 'Učitaj pregled i proveri ishod' (review exists and uncertain||error) with loading={editor.loading}. Published -> brand 'Otvori zadatak'. Command branch unchanged ('Objavi ovaj nacrt' / 'Nastavi istu objavu' brand with loading, 'Izmeni zadatak' brand, 'Proveri stanje nacrta' / 'Proveri objavu', 'Otvori moje zadatke'). No command -> the existing custom Press publish button (keep it; its states are pinned: accessibilityState, wash fill when resting, green + ActivityIndicator only while publishing), then ONE caption line T meta centered: the FIRST blocking reason in short form ('Prvo reši ono što još treba.' when any Još treba item exists; 'Sačuvaj ili otkaži otvorenu izmenu.' / 'Sačuvaj ili zatvori rok za prijave.' for open editors; IDENTITY copy is not repeated here), else the unchanged acceptance sentence 'Ovim prihvataš prikazanu verziju i tražiš objavu.' / 'Ovim potvrđuješ ovu verziju zadatka i tražiš njenu objavu.' Then quiet 'Sačuvaj nacrt' (same condition).
KEYBOARD: KeyboardAvoidingView behavior 'height' on Android as well (LocationScreen already does), and scroll the edited row into view when its editor opens (scrollTo from onLayout y).

LARGE TEXT / 320 dp: preview head stacks (value under title) at scale >= 1.3; rows always stacked at >= 1.3; section header rows wrap (header text flex 1, action keeps its 48 px); publish label wraps (publishLabel flexShrink kept); no fixed heights anywhere except the 160 map and square tiles.

MOTION: none except SuccessMark on a real publish in this mount and the V2Action/confirm spinners; nothing fades a fact; reduced motion from useReducedMotion only (SuccessMark and TurningCaret already obey it).
states: Loading (first read): StateView loading 'Pripremamo pregled…'. Re-read with a review: body stays, footer 'Učitaj pregled i proveri ishod' shows loading, every command greys (existing disabled rule).
Error without review: StateView error 'Pregled nije učitan' + editor.error + 'Učitaj pregled i proveri ishod'. Error with review: red alert line in the footer above the recovery button (as today).
Offline: no separate detection; the service message arrives as editor.error and is shown as above. Do not invent 'Nema veze'.
Disabled-with-reason: publish resting (wash) + caption with the first reason; Još treba lists every blocker with its way to fix it.
Busy publishing: publish green with spinner and busy state (unchanged); a draft or fact save leaves publish grey and still (unchanged, pinned).
Editor open (fact / deadline): publish grey with 'Sačuvaj ili otkaži otvorenu izmenu.' / 'Sačuvaj ili zatvori rok za prijave.'
Uncertain outcome: all writes frozen until explicit read (unchanged); status block shows 'Objava još nije potvrđena. Proveri ishod pre novog pokušaja.'
Success: status block greenSoft with SuccessMark (fresh only when published here), title 'Objavljeno', footer brand 'Otvori zadatak'.
Private draft (ACCEPTED): neutral status block 'Sačuvano kao privatan nacrt. Zadatak nije objavljen.', footer 'Objavi ovaj nacrt' brand + 'Proveri stanje nacrta' + 'Otvori moje zadatke'.
Empty sections: no photos -> 'Fotografije nisu dodate.'; no private facts -> no 'Samo u Dogovoru' group; REMOTE -> 'Na daljinu' only.
keepUntouched: ReviewedTaskRoute key `${user?.id}:${accountRevision}:${conversationId}` and uuid() validation of the param (:45-50).

read(): focus scope + account/revision current() checks, pending.current retained review identity, readLatest vs read(reviewId), published readback against izvor.potreba revision and state list, geographical recovery against needLocationClientService.read and geographyRevision, locationConflict, deadlineProposal/locationProposal semantics, prepare() arguments (:75-121).

accept(): canAct and every guard (canAccept, unavailableIdentityFact, edit, locationEditor, deadlineEditor, command, accountId), retained { review, id: noviUuidZahtevId() } command identity, started/publishing bookkeeping (:136-152).

resume(), saveEdit() with correctionFromText, removeUnavailableIdentityRequirement() writing false/'Ne', openLocation(), proposeLocation() (review-only, never needLocationClientService.save), proposeDeadline(), revisePublishedDraft() supported/unavailable exits (:154-227).
useOwnedEditor ownership, canAct/navigate once, refresh rules, useFocusEffect cleanup that closes editors and cancels the resolver.
The custom publish Press and its accessibilityLabel/accessibilityState/fill/spinner contract (:423-427) and all footer command labels.
resultCopy strings and their state mapping (:255-265); SupportContextEntry wiring for EVALUATED + REVIEW only.
'Sačuvaj nacrt' only for !revising && canAccept && !unavailableIdentityFact.
The need.category exclusion from rows and the EMPTY_VALUE/showEmpty mechanism.
The _layout.tsx FLOW_BEHIND rule and the replace targets ('/potrebe/[id]/pregled', '/potrebe', '/nova' with conversationId).

src/data/__tests__/aiNeedV2Ui.test.ts: unchanged (factReviewValue untouched); ADD tests for reviewRowValue (minutes only, 'po vremenu u Srbiji' only off-zone, novac grouping, resolved_location without coordinates) and for publicAnchorPoint (start vs serviceArea anchor, half-away-from-zero rounding of negative E6).

screens.route: /pregled-zadatka place mode (locationEditor open) = NeedLocationForm reviewOnly + LocationPointEditor + LocationControls + CountryField
screens.purpose: Editing the task's place as its own step: what everybody sees (country, mode, city/area text, approximate area) clearly separated from what only a Dogovor reveals (the exact point on the map, the exact address, access notes), with honest map/search states and ONE green action ('Primeni izmenu mesta') that prepares a new review without saving canonical facts.
problems: Up to three primaries at once (AUDIT.md row /pregled-zadatka): the form's save is V2Action kind 'primary' = INK surface (NeedLocationForm.tsx:179), the point editor's 'Potvrdi tačku: X' is also kind 'primary' ink (LocationPointEditor.tsx:214), and the review's own publish stays drawn (disabled) under the inline editor (pregled-zadatka.tsx:342-344 + footer). Neither ink button is the app's green brand action.

Card inside a card: the 'Mesta na mapi' block is locationStyles.card (NeedLocationForm.tsx:144) and LocationPointEditor renders another locationStyles.card inside it (LocationPointEditor.tsx:166); PlaceFields is a third card (NeedLocationForm.tsx:26).

The editor is injected at the top of the review scroll above the facts (pregled-zadatka.tsx:342-344) with a 320 px interactive map inside the review ScrollView, while the rest of the review (and its publish footer) stays under it; 'Nazad na pregled' is a quiet button at the end of a very long form (:344).
'Odbaci nepotvrđenu tačku' is drawn TWICE while a point is pending (NeedLocationForm.tsx:161-162 and :176-177).

Gendered copy: 'Proverio/la sam javno mesto i privatne podatke.' (:169), 'Potvrdi tačku na mapi da bi sačuvao mesto.' (:175), 'da bi sačuvao mesto' in saveBlockReason (:195, :197); 'Tačku možeš izabrati sam na mapi.' (LocationPointEditor.tsx:177), 'Možeš je uneti sam.' (:182), button 'Izaberi tačku sam na mapi' (:196).

Loading is a label swap ('Pripremamo mesto…', NeedLocationForm.tsx:179) instead of the V2Action loading state; a muted line always stands under the live save explaining the flow ('Mesto će biti prikazano u završnom pregledu. Zadatak još nije objavljen.', :185) - explanation copy.

Explanatory copy: intro 'Unesi mesto gde je potrebna pomoć. GPS dozvola nije potrebna.' (:99) and 'Izaberi pravo mesto ako pretraga ponudi više rezultata. Sve podatke prihvataš zajedno tek pri objavi.' (:146).

Private data is split without a frame: task-level exact address/notes in 'Privatni detalji Zadatka' (:137-143) and per-point private address/notes in the point editor's own disclosure (LocationPointEditor.tsx:200-206); nothing on screen groups 'what others see' vs 'only in a Dogovor'.
Search candidates are full-width quiet buttons whose visible text is 'Izaberi predlog: <whole address>' (LocationPointEditor.tsx:185-187) - a list of long green sentences.

LocationDetails draws its own caret with a static transform (LocationControls.tsx:39) instead of the shared TurningCaret; LocationChoice is a hand-made Modal sheet (:70-91), one of the nine Modals the master plan replaces with the shared sheet.

CountryField shows its load error inside a GREEN notice (CountryField.tsx:37, locationStyles.notice = greenSoft) and its loading as a plain body line (:35); unavailable countries are drawn at opacity 0.5 with no reason (LocationControls.tsx:82).
composition: ENTRY/EXIT: when locationEditor is set, pregled-zadatka renders the PLACE MODE instead of the review body: chrome DetailTopBar title 'Mesto zadatka', backLabel 'Nazad na pregled', disabled={editor.busy}, onBack = () => { resolver.cancel(); setLocationEditor(null); }. Android hardware Back while in place mode closes the editor the same way (BackHandler listener registered inside the existing useFocusEffect while locationEditor is set; return true). The review footer (publish, draft) is NOT rendered in place mode; accept() keeps its locationEditor guard. Remove the quiet 'Nazad na pregled' V2Action (:344).

NeedLocationForm gets an optional prop `layout?: 'inline' | 'screen'` (default 'inline' keeps today's behaviour for any caller). With 'screen' it returns <View style={{ flex: 1 }}><ScrollView keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 20, gap: 24, paddingBottom: 32 }}>{body}</ScrollView><View style={footer}>{save}</View></View>, the footer styled like SettingsFooter (hairline top, padding lg). pregled-zadatka and mesto-zadatka both pass 'screen' and do NOT wrap it in another ScrollView.

BODY top to bottom: (1) !review.editable -> T alert 'Ovaj pregled više nije dostupan za izmene. Vrati se na Zadatak.' (unchanged). (2) LocationDetails 'Država i način rada' (unchanged label, summary, initiallyOpen rule) containing CountryField 'Država Zadatka' and LocationChoice 'Način rada'. (3) GROUP 'Vide svi': header row FactArt eye 18 + T label 'Vide svi'. PlaceFields WITHOUT card: T bodyStrong title ('Mesto rada' / 'Polazište' / 'Područje rada' / 'Početna tačka' / 'Stanica N' / 'Odredište'), LocationField '<title> — grad ili mesto', LocationDetails '<title> — dodatni javni opis' with the two optional fields and the unchanged public hint 'Ovo je javno. Unesi samo približno područje, bez adrese, broja stana ili kontakta.' Area start point and multi-stop controls keep their labels ('Dodaj početnu tačku (opciono)', 'Ukloni početnu tačku', 'Dodaj stanicu', 'Ukloni stanicu N', 'Pomeri stanicu N ranije'); the two per-stop quiet actions sit in one wrapping row. REMOTE -> the unchanged greenSoft notice 'Rad na daljinu nema adresu, pin ili radijus. Čuvanjem se uklanjaju podaci o fizičkom mestu iz ovog pregleda.' and nothing else in groups 3-4. (4) GROUP 'Samo u Dogovoru' (hairline above, header FactArt lock 18 + T label 'Samo u Dogovoru'): PrivateLocationNote (text verbatim); T bodyStrong `Potvrđeno tačaka: ${done} od ${total}`; slot LocationChoice 'Tačka koju uređuješ' when > 1 slot (unchanged options incl. ' · potvrđeno'); LocationPointEditor (no card, see below); the task-level LocationDetails 'Privatni detalji Zadatka' with 'Tačna adresa (privatno, opciono)' and 'Napomene za pristup (privatno, opciono)' (labels pinned). When points < slots: one T meta muted 'Lokacija je potpuno potvrđena tek kada potvrdiš sve tačke.' Before a country/place exists: T 'Prvo unesi državu i javno mesto za potrebne tačke.' (unchanged). (5) invalid -> T alert danger (unchanged text). (6) !reviewOnly only: LocationConfirmation (accessibilityLabel 'Potvrđujem unetu lokaciju' unchanged) with text REMOTE 'Potvrđujem da se Zadatak radi na daljinu.' else 'Javno mesto i privatni podaci su provereni.'

Delete: the intro line (:99), the reviewOnly/!reviewOnly meta under the map heading (:145-146; the heading itself moves into the group header), the duplicate 'Odbaci nepotvrđenu tačku' inside the card (:161-162), the pending block above the save (:174-178) and the always-on muted line (:183-185) except as below.

FOOTER (sticky): <V2Action style={brandAction} label={reviewOnly ? 'Primeni izmenu mesta' : 'Potvrdi i sačuvaj mesto'} loading={busy} disabled={same rule as :180} reason={saveBlockReason(...)} onPress={submit} />; while pendingPoint also a quiet V2Action 'Odbaci nepotvrđenu tačku' under it (the one and only copy). saveBlockReason gains the pending case and loses gender: pendingPoint -> 'Potvrdi tačku na mapi, pa sačuvaj mesto.'; !countryChosen -> 'Izaberi državu u „Država i način rada“, pa sačuvaj mesto.'; !confirmed -> 'Označi potvrdu iznad, pa sačuvaj mesto.'; others unchanged. For !reviewOnly and a LIVE save, one T note muted under it: 'Čuva se mesto u istom pregledu. Zadatak još nije objavljen.' (pinned). reviewOnly with a live save: no line.

LocationPointEditor (shared with ConversationPointAsk in /nova): root View gap 12, NO locationStyles.card. Heading T bodyStrong `${title} na mapi`; keep the meta 'Izaberi tačno mesto i potvrdi ga. Tačka i detalji ispod ostaju privatni.' (the conversation sheet has no group header). Search field + 'Pronađi na mapi' secondary (labels unchanged, 'Tražimo mesto…' / 'Pokušaj ponovo' unchanged). Candidates: V2Action kind 'secondary' with icon <FactArt kind='pin' size={18} />, label = candidate.label, accessibilityLabel = `Izaberi predlog: ${label}` (reverse: `Koristi privatnu adresu: ${label}`), stacked with gap 8. 'Pretraga: LocationIQ · izvori podataka' attribution link stays, wrapped in a Press with minHeight 48. Copy fixes: 'Pretraga mesta još nije aktivirana. Tačku izaberi dodirom na mapi.'; 'Adresa za ovu tačku nije pronađena. Upiši je ručno.'; button 'Izaberi tačku na mapi'. Map unchanged. Status line unchanged.
